Shanghai Municipal Police.
Central Police Station.
November 6, 1922.

REPORT ON Arrival of steamer from Vladivostock.

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

The S.S. Lorestan, agents Messrs. L. V. Lang & Co., arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock via Fusan and Tsingtao at 9 a.m. November 5 and docked at the South Manchuria Railway Co.'s Whangpoo Wharf. The vessel was met by D. I's. Cruikshank and Sullivan, D. S. Schmidt, D. Cs. Korolkoff, and Repas, and P. C. C. Papp. She had on board 28 first class, 16 second class and 150 third class passengers. Amongst the passengers were General Soulevich, former Vladivostock Commandant, General Yushchenko, Military Engineer, General Pooloosky, Chairman of the Union of ex-Military Officers at Vladivostock, and ten members of the board of the above Union, Colonel Novgorodtzeff, Assistant to the Chief of Vladivostock Militia, Colonel Baron Unterberger, Military Engineer, son of the former Governor General of Primorie, Colonel Dvinogossky of General Diederichs Staff, Colonel Kuzminsky, formerly of General Rozanoff's staff Reverend Prozoroff, priest of the Vladivostock Cathedral,

The Captain of the S. S. "Lorestan" states that the passengers are nearly all well provided with money and that they have considerable quantities of gold roubles with them. They are all better class people and many of them have been employed in the various Government offices in Vladivostock. When the ship left Vladivostock she had on board 400 passengers, 166 of whom left the ship at Fusan to proceed by rail to Harbin, and 40 at Tsingtao. The ship sailed from Vladivostock on October 22 and most of the passengers boarded the vessel in a state of panic three days before she sailed. The Captain states that he objected

关于从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达的轮船的报告。

由巡官 D. I. Sullivan 撰写，经 [签名] 转呈

先生：

“洛雷斯坦”号（S.S. Lorestan）轮船，代理人为 L. V. Lang & Co. 公司，于11月5日上午9时经由釜山和青岛从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，并停靠在南满洲铁道株式会社的黄浦码头。该船由巡官 Cruikshank 和 Sullivan、副巡官 Schmidt、华籍巡长 Korolkoff 以及 Repas 和警员 Papp 前往迎候。船上载有一等舱乘客28名，二等舱乘客16名，三等舱乘客150名。乘客中包括前符拉迪沃斯托克司令 Soulevich 将军、军事工程师 Yushchenko 将军、符拉迪沃斯托克退役军官联盟主席 Pooloosky 将军，以及上述联盟的十名董事会成员、符拉迪沃斯托克民团团长助理 Novgorodtzeff 上校、军事工程师 Baron Unterberger 上校（前滨海边疆区总督之子）、Diederichs 将军参谋部的 Dvinogossky 上校、前 Rozanoff 将军参谋部的 Kuzminsky 上校、符拉迪沃斯托克大教堂牧师 Prozoroff 神父，

November 7, 1922.

REPORT ON Arrival of steamer from Vladivostock.

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by J. Gwén x 9.

Sir,
The S. S. "Heinpøigan" agents messrs Wallem & Co, 1B
Hankow Road, arrived in Shanghai on the night of Nov. 5
from Vladivostock via Chefoo and moored at the Tatung Wharf
Chinese Bund. When the vessel left Vladivostock she had
on board 91 Russian passengers including men, women, and
children. Twenty passengers left the ship at Chefoo and
71 came to Shanghai. The passengers are all better class
people and being apparently in possession of ample funds are
not likely to become destitute at least for some considerable
time. The steamer is being taken off the Vladivostock run.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Sullivan.
D. I.

D. C. I.

关于从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达的轮船的报告。

由巡官 D. I. Sullivan 撰写，经 J. Gwén x 9 转呈。

先生：
“Heinpøigan”号轮船，代理人为位于汉口路1B号的 Wallem & Co. 公司，于11月5日晚间经由烟台从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，并停泊在华界外滩的大通码头。该船离开符拉迪沃斯托克时，船上有91名俄罗斯乘客，包括男性、女性和儿童。20名乘客在烟台离船，71人抵达上海。乘客均属较上层人士，且显然拥有充裕资金，至少在相当长的一段时间内不太可能陷入贫困。该轮船正被撤出符拉迪沃斯托克航线。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
Sullivan.
巡官。

副巡官。
